text: This clinic is an absolute disaster. The problem is that the receptionist is never at her desk, and when you call, no one answers because she's constantly out. I had an appointment that I wanted to reschedule because of rain, but after 20 minutes on the phone, I couldn't reach anyone. When I finally arrived, there was no one at reception. All the staff were chatting casually in the back rooms, and no one was paying any attention to the reception desk. So I complained. The dentist then immediately refused to treat me, claiming she couldn't perform root canals and that I would have to go to a specialist clinic—even though there are advertisements for comprehensive root canal treatments outside.
